channel.title: Wisconsin Newspaper Association - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Wisconsin Newspaper Association (wnanews.com)

item.title: OMG appoints Tompkins publisher of Wisconsin Media Group
item.description: O’Rourke Media Group has named JJ Tompkins as publisher of its Wisconsin Media Group, which includes nine hyper-local community newspapers and affiliated websites across the state.

item.title: Your right to information is under attack
item.description: Good journalism steps on toes. Indiscriminately. To the left. To the right. The best journalists do not want or need your love. They do want you to have facts, including the facts you might prefer not to see or read.

item.title: Longtime News-Shield cartoonist dies
item.description: Minnesota cartoonist Ed Fischer, whose humorous drawings have entertained Barron News-Shield readers for decades, died Saturday, Jan. 24, 2026, according to an email message his daughter, Rebekka Fischer.

item.title: Neenah News adds new staff reporters
item.description: The Winnebago Media Group has added three new reporters to its staff at the Neenah News.

item.title: Judge rejects city request to dismiss records lawsuit
item.description: Ozaukee County Circuit Judge Adam Gerol last week rejected a request by the City of Port Washington to dismiss a lawsuit brought by Town of Port resident Lynde Uihlein, who said the city has not complied with an open records request she made seeking documents relating to Vantage Data Centers Lighthouse Campus on the city’s north side.

item.title: Wisconsin Valentine’s itinerary
item.description: Valentine’s Day doesn’t have to be about chocolate hearts and clichés: It can be about experiences, connections, and discovering the best Wisconsin has to offer.

item.title: Remembering my mother the farm wife
item.description: My muse told me a couple of weeks ago that I should share the story about my mother’s dementia and her joy when we gave her a doll for Christmas. It was the last conversation that we shared. Mom died Jan. 29 just eight days short of what would have been her 88th birthday.

item.title: $1 million withheld over time at resort
item.description: Lawmakers are withholding a tenth of the state Department of Public Instruction’s budget over a report that showed the department spent nearly $369,000 on a four-day workshop at a Wisconsin Dells resort in 2024.

item.title: Board president investigation cost $20,499
item.description: The cost of the investigation of a citizen’s complaint against Clintonville Board of Education President Glen Drew Lundt has reached $20,499, but not all the invoices regarding the investigation have been received by the district.

item.title: Webster Lions donate $2,500 to ICCPA Foundation
item.description: Richard Lee, Kim Talmadge and Gayle Olson from the ICCPA Foundation Inc. accepted a $2,500 donation from John Vandergon from the Webster Lions Club.
